caseNameFull: Sherwin v. United States and Sheridan v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Earl C. Demoss for petitioners.

opinions.text:
On petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.

The motion to use the record in Nos. 319 and 320 is granted. The petition for writs of certiorari to . the Circuit Court of . Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, and the motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, are denied.

Reported below: 118 F. 2d 828.
